# The modelcontextprotocol/registry files Preflight ports, and the registry
# commit they were last checked against. .github/registry-drift.sh compares
# each file at that commit with the registry's main. When one changes, read
# the change, update the port if it needs it, then move the commit here
# (the full 40-character SHA: GitHub fetches only those).
